title: ilex umbellata var. genuina
intro: Ilex umbellata var. genuina, commonly known as American Holly, is a species of flowering plant in the family Aquifoliaceae. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, which include providing relief from fever, rheumatism, and digestive issues. The health benefits of American Holly are attributed to its therapeutic actions, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiseptic properties.
